entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I, uh, I need to make a return. I ordered a helmet and I just... I don't think I can keep it. I feel terrible about it.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To get started, could you please provide me with your order number?
Yes, it's VF88602. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, I really love your products. I just really needed the money back for something that came up unexpectedly.

Thank you, I see the order for the Trail Helmet right here. I understand that things come up. So I can best assist you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference?

Oh, no, it's not broken or anything. It's just... the color. It looked different on the website, and it just doesn't feel right. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched the helmet itself. I feel so guilty for even calling.

Please don't feel guilty at all. It's important that you're completely happy with your gear. Getting the right color matters. And your safety is our top priority, so we want you to feel confident in the equipment you use.

Let me just check the policy for you. Okay, I see your order was delivered 9 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Diana. I was so worried it would be a problem. That really helps me out a lot.

You're very welcome. It's no problem at all. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the shipping box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed.
I see the email. Thank you again, you've been wonderful.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Great. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
